## Library Loading

```{r}
#| message: false
library("here")
library("tidyverse")
```

Data paths:

```{r}
data_dir <- here("data")
```

## Augment donor metadata

### Read file

```{r}
donor_metadata <- read.csv(str_c(data_dir,"/03_donor_metadata_clean.csv"))

```

### Read file

```{r}
donor_metadata <- donor_metadata |>
  mutate(group_colors=case_when(
    alzheimer=="yes" & num_tbi_w_loc==0 ~ "blue",
    alzheimer=="yes" & num_tbi_w_loc!=0 ~ "red",
    alzheimer=="no" & num_tbi_w_loc==0 ~ "green",
    alzheimer=="no" & num_tbi_w_loc!=0 ~ "yellow",
  ))

```

### Write augmented file

```{r}
metadata_file <- str_c(data_dir, "/04_donor_metadata_aug.csv")
write_csv(x = donor_metadata,
          file = metadata_file)
```
